items.title: A WYSIWYG word processor in Python
items.raw_excerpt: Hi all, Finding a good data structure for a word processor is a difficult problem. My notebook diaries on the problem go back 25 years when I was frustrated with using Word for my diploma thesis - it was slow and unstable at that time. I ended up getting pretty hooked on the problem. Right now I’m taking a professional break and decided to finally use the time to push these ideas further, and build MiniWord — a WYSIWYG word processor in Python. My goal is to have a native, non-HTML-based editor that stays simple, fast, and is hackable. So far I am focusing on getting the fundamentals right. What is working yet is: - Real WYSIWYG editing (no HTML layer, no embedded browser) with styles, images and tables. - Clean, simple file format (human-readable, diff-friendly, git-friendly, AI-friendly)

items.title: 从汽车到物理 AI：何小鹏眼中的智能汽车下半场

Author: Yang Yiting Editor: Bao Yonggang

At last year's CFMS | MemoryS Summit, storage manufacturers discussed when prices would stabilize, when QLC would scale up, and when AI PCs would be realized. At that time, "AI will make storage more fundamental and critical" was more of an industry prediction, a trend forecast for the future. 

A year later, at the MemoryS 2026 conference, the questions have completely changed. 

Discussions no longer focus solely on bit costs, chip supply, and capacity schedules but also on GPU utilization, token costs, system scheduling efficiency, and even real-time decision-making capabilities in physical AI scenarios. Issues originally belonging to AI infrastructure and system architecture are increasingly appearing at the center of storage industry discussions. 

In traditional computing architectures, the role of storage is primarily to "store." Data is written, retained, and retrieved when needed, otherwise remaining quietly at the edge of the system. It has long been an item in the BOM cost, a capacity planning issue, rarely directly influencing the definition of computational efficiency. 

However, in the era of large model training and inference, this role has been completely rewritten. 

The access latency of KV Cache now directly affects token generation rates; the write efficiency of Checkpoints determines the waiting time of GPUs during training; the IOPS density of SSDs further impacts concurrency and system throughput in large model inference scenarios. 

Storage is now entering the main path of computation, determining the speed of data flow.

excerpt_i18n.en: No one misses Xiaoice more than Li Di. "Our current company is called Mingri Xin Cheng because I can't call it Xiaoice; if I could, I would." As the founder of the new company, Li Di still speaks with evident fondness about the AI product he developed from scratch. Known as the "father of Xiaoice," this identity has been his most prominent label and the AI product to which he has dedicated over a decade. However, everything changed after the Spring Festival in 2025—first, he was removed from his position in February, and then in late November, the core product X Eva officially ceased service, putting Xiaoice's story on hold. This was not a graceful farewell. Li Di, along with a core team, pivoted to the intelligent entity track in December 2025, making their debut at Ji Qi's Creators Forum under the name "Mingri Xin Cheng." The team remains small, with fewer than twenty members. We met Li Di twice in Wudaokou, once at the end of 2025 and again at the beginning of 2026. Reflecting on the past, Li Di tries to view and let go of it as an observer, but he still self-deprecates and harbors some regrets—"The only thing I truly regret is not developing a reasoning model at the end of 23." In his recollection, each technical decision corresponds to a window of opportunity: "I may have just lost a name, but Xiaoice lost a year and a half to two years." From this perspective, Xiaoice's growth trajectory, as well as the divergences and choices at critical junctures, take on another layer of meaning. items.raw_excerpt: 近日，豆包APP实时语音通话功能升级，上线全双工语音大模型Seeduplex 。据介绍，作为原生全双工端到端语音大模型，Seeduplex 能够在复杂声学场景下实现精准抗干扰与动态判停，提供更顺畅、更自然的语音交互体验。 此次更新后，豆包实时语音通话功能在对话自然度、响应速度和抗干扰能力等方面均有提升。 记者实测发现，升级后的豆包语音通话在复杂环境下表现出较强的抗干扰能力，即便周围存在人声和噪音干扰，也能较准确地识别用户语音，不易被无关声音带偏。以餐厅、展览等易出现多人交谈的场景为例，过往 AI 产品容易因背景噪音或旁人说话声出现误打断、误回复等情况；此次升级后，豆包对无关声音的过滤能力有所增强，对话过程也更不容易被人声意外打断。 除抗干扰能力外，升级后的语音对话节奏也更接近自然交流。人与人对话中，停顿并不总意味着发言结束。此次升级后，豆包可结合语音与语义信息判断用户是否仍在继续表达，从而减少对话中的“抢话”现象。与此同时，对话响应时延也进一步降低，在接龙、飞花令等高频互动场景中表现更为明显。 目前，这一能力已在豆包 APP上线。用户可点击“打电话”按钮，开启实时语音通话功能体验。 雷峰网

Recently, the Doubao app has upgraded its real-time voice call feature with the launch of the full-duplex voice model Seeduplex. As a native full-duplex end-to-end voice model, Seeduplex can achieve precise interference resistance and dynamic pause detection in complex acoustic environments, providing smoother and more natural voice interaction experiences. After this update, the Doubao real-time voice call function has improved in terms of conversation naturalness, response speed, and interference resistance.

Journalists found that the upgraded Doubao voice calls show strong interference resistance in complex environments. Even with surrounding voices and noise, it can accurately recognize user speech without being misled by irrelevant sounds. In scenarios like restaurants or exhibitions where multiple conversations often occur, previous AI products would frequently misinterpret background noise or other people's voices, leading to interruptions or incorrect responses. With this upgrade, Doubao has enhanced its ability to filter out irrelevant sounds, making conversations less likely to be interrupted by external voices.

In addition to improved interference resistance, the rhythm of the upgraded voice conversations is closer to natural exchanges. In human conversations, pauses do not always indicate the end of a statement. The updated Doubao can now use both voice and semantic information to determine if the user is still speaking, reducing the "talking over" phenomenon. Furthermore, the response latency has been reduced, which is particularly noticeable in high-frequency interactive scenes such as word games and rapid-fire questions.

This capability is now available in the Doubao app. Users can click the "Call" button to start the real-time voice call feature.

Pruebas realizadas por periodistas han demostrado que la llamada de voz de Doudou, tras la actualización, muestra una fuerte capacidad de resistencia a interferencias en entornos complejos, pudiendo identificar con precisión la voz del usuario incluso en presencia de ruidos y voces ajenas.

excerpt_i18n.zh: 4月8日，百度官微正式官宣，Create 2026 百度AI开发者大会（以下简称“Create2026”）将于5月13日至14日在北京举办。据悉，百度或将发布在「芯-云-模-体」全栈AI布局、产业应用、AI生态等方面的最新进展。目前大会已开放售票通道（https://ai-conference.baidu.com/marketing/ai-conference/ticket/fullpass）    官方信息显示，今年Create战略升级，有效整合“Create百度AI开发者大会”、“云智大会”两大峰会，打造百度集团面向企业、合作伙伴、开发者的全景界面，其中百度智能云将在 AI Infra 与 Agent Infra 两大核心方向实现重大突破，并携多款全新产品重磅亮相。 据介绍，Create 2026以「万物一体」为主题，设置开幕式、2场主论坛及20+专题论坛。开幕式上，百度创始人李彦宏将发表主题演讲，分享最新AI趋势判断；2场主论坛由百度智能云承办，“技术与产品”主论坛将重磅发布百度全栈AI产品进展，深度解码AI价值落地全路径，助力企业迈向Agent时代，国内首个“超级个体”主论坛届时将集中亮相一系列专为超级个体打造的产品，全面赋能个体在AI时代的能力提升与“一人公司”发展；20+分论坛覆盖AI Infra、OpenClaw、数字人、具身智能、AI+产业等AI热门赛道，系统展示AI从基础设施建设到产业应用的全链路进化。 此外，Create 2026将推出30+AI公开课，高密度输出AI应用实操干货，并配套开放麦、迷你黑客松等创新活动。大会现场还将打造10000㎡ AI展区，集中呈现百度全栈AI落地实践，同时展示AI生态成果与行业标杆案例，为参会观众提供趣味性与实用性兼备的赶“AI大集”体验。 作为全球首个AI开发者大会，Create大会已举办7届，文心
excerpt_i18n.en: On April 8, Baidu officially announced that the Create 2026 Baidu AI Developer Conference (hereinafter referred to as "Create2026") will be held in Beijing from May 13 to 14. It is reported that Baidu may release the latest progress in its full-stack AI layout of "chip-cloud-model-body," industrial applications, and AI ecosystem. The conference ticketing channel is now open (https://ai-conference.baidu.com/marketing/ai-conference/ticket/fullpass). Official information indicates that this year's Create has been strategically upgraded, effectively integrating the "Create Baidu AI Developer Conference" and the "Cloud Intelligence Conference" into a comprehensive interface for Baidu Group, targeting enterprises, partners, and developers. Baidu Smart Cloud will achieve significant breakthroughs in AI Infra and Agent Infra, showcasing multiple new products. Create 2026, themed "Unity of All Things," features an opening ceremony, two main forums, and over 20 specialized forums. At the opening ceremony, Baidu founder Robin Li will deliver a keynote speech, sharing insights on the latest AI trends. The two main forums, hosted by Baidu Smart Cloud, will highlight the company's full-stack AI product advancements and provide a deep dive into the entire path of AI value realization, assisting enterprises in transitioning to the Agent era, marking the first in China.
